Card Q&A.q: With this card's [When Digivolving] effect, can I suspend this Digimon itself in order to suspend 1 of my opponent's Digimon?

Effect: [When Digivolving] You may suspend 1 of your Digimon to suspend 1 of your opponent's Digimon.
Inherited Effect: [All Turns] This Digimon gets +1000 DP for each of your other suspended Digimon.
